description: This PHP source file defines the Payments class, which provides methods to calculate financial cash flow metrics such as annuity payments and interest payments in a financial calculations library. It includes functions for validating input parameters, handling errors, and performing the core financial formulas.

classes.name: Payments
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute financial periodic cash flows such as payment for an annuity and interest components for loan payments.

methods.name: annuity
methods.description: Calculates the constant payment amount (annuity) for a series of cash flows with a given interest rate, number of periods, present value, future value, and payment timing.

methods.name: interestPayment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a specific period for an investment or loan, given the interest rate, total number of periods, present value, future value, and payment timing.
